entities.summary: Hwang Yun-gil, also known as Hwang Yun'gil, was a Korean diplomat and ambassador of the Joseon period. He was a member of the Western faction in the court. He represented Joseon's interests in a Joseon Tongsinsa to Sengoku Japan under the control of Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
